profile_text.body:
Symbotic Inc. is a public company headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker SYM. According to its website, it provides end-to-end warehouse automation systems for retailers and distributors, combining robotics with AI software. The company describes its systems as able to increase facility capacity through dense storage, maximize throughput, and extend efficiency gains across the supply chain. It says its solutions handle goods ranging from 1 lb (0.5 kg) and 2 x 6.4 x 5 in (5.1 x 16.3 x 12.7 cm) up to 60 lb (27.2 kg) and 36 x 24 x 16.2 in (91.4 x 61 x 41.2 cm) in their native packaging, and that loose items and cold chain requirements also have automation options.

Symbotic positions itself as a turnkey provider and the software and key robotic innovator for each solution, contrasting this with integrators it says are limited by their portfolio of technology partnerships. The company describes itself as a leader in industrial automation and in technology at large, and states its purpose as getting the right goods to people who need them, when they need them.

The company's record shows a CIK of 0001837240 and a Massachusetts law exposure count of 191. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for it.
